_doc: Optional 'from the floor' notes for the weekly Cost Index dispatch, authored by Don Goldstein and keyed by edition asOf. The note interprets what is ON the page; it may NOT introduce a new number, a new ingredient, or a forecast. Every number in the text must trace to that edition's snapshot in data/cost-index-editions.json (or to data/sourced-claims.json). Gated by scripts/check-cost-index-editors-note.mjs, plus the standard fabrication + banned-words gates. Most weeks ship without a note; absence is the default.

2026-06-18.author: Don Goldstein
2026-06-18.text: The produce side is doing all the talking this week. Avocado at +68.6% against its baseline and the lettuces clustered right behind it, while the proteins sit quiet against their own windows. When the board tilts this hard toward produce, the move I make is narrow: re-price the salads and the garnish-heavy plates, leave the center of the plate alone, and check the avocado invoice against the wholesale read before assuming the jump is mine to eat.
